propositions: The code-review extension seam is incomplete: project criteria can be routed but are not dynamically fanned into Pass 1, not resolved through existing eval surfaces, and not consulted with repository awareness in Pass 3.

Logical project.<name> identifiers must map to validator-safe physical code-review-project-<name> identifiers at prompt and eval dispatch without introducing special cases in deterministic Pass 3 routing.

A co-located project criterion project.review-phase-boundaries must enforce four-phase separation by preventing Pass 1 from assessing severity or prescribing fixes, Pass 2 from discovering new findings, Pass 3 from running LLM logic, and Pass 4 from re-verifying or changing disposition.

The project criterion must be authored with balanced eval corpus (RP-F1..RP-F6 positive cases, RP-N1..RP-N6 negative cases), configured with block_threshold 0.90 and blocking_enabled false, and validated through offline evals and live Gerrit dogfooding before any blocking promotion.
Overlay-absent repositories must preserve pre-change behavior and be protected by compatibility test coverage as the generic seam fan-in and routing repair is deployed.
Existing suggested_fix field support remains unchanged grandfathered debt; only new or expanded Pass-1 remediation directives constitute violations of the four-phase contract.
